blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The National Transmission Corporation (TransCo) said that households and businesses in Mindoro can help manage electricity supply amid a possible strong El Niño by cutting down on unnecessary power use, especially during the dry season when hydropower output may drop. TransCo President and Chief Executive Officer Atty. Joseph Omar Castillo made the appeal in a recent radio interview, noting that Mindoro draws around 12 to 14 megawatts from hydropower, making water availability a critical concern during an extended dry spell. “In Mindoro, we expect 12 to 14 megawatts from hydro.
